ucs.title: [LLM] Akira rclone/WinSCP staged exfiltration to MEGA before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature pre-encryption exfiltration: rclone.exe (often renamed) or WinSCP running with a MEGA / mega.nz / mega.co.nz target, typically launched from C:\Users\Public, C:\PerfLogs, or C:\ProgramData. Akira (GOLD SAHARA / PUNK SPIDER / Howling Scorpius) is one of the most consistent rclone-to-MEGA operators in the e-crime ecosystem — CISA AA24-109A and Mandiant both call this out as a stable IOC for the affiliate program.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_path) as path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process_name="winscp.com" OR Processes.process_name="winscp.exe" OR Processes.process_name="filezilla.exe") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR Processes.process="*copy*remote*" OR Processes.process="*sync*remote*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Music\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Intel\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename firstTime as firstTime lastTime as lastTime | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RcloneIndicators = dynamic(["mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--config","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","copy remote","sync remote"," copy "," sync "]);
let StagingPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\",@"\PerfLogs\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Windows\Temp\",@"\Intel\",@"\Music\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","winscp.com","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe")
         or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
         or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneIndicators)
| where FolderPath has_any (StagingPaths) or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (StagingPaths)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          OriginalName = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RcloneIndicators = dynamic(["mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--config","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","copy remote","sync remote"]);
let StagingPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\",@"\PerfLogs\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Windows\Temp\",@"\Intel\",@"\Music\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where Img endswith "\\rclone.exe" or Img endswith "\\winscp.com" or Img endswith "\\winscp.exe" or Img endswith "\\filezilla.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (RcloneIndicators)
| where NewProcessName has_any (StagingPaths)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira rclone or WinSCP exfiltration to MEGA from staging directory
id: 5b1c0e1a-4ed1-4e07-9b9a-ak1ra-mega-exfil
status: experimental
description: Detects Akira-style data staging where rclone.exe (often renamed) or WinSCP is run from Public/PerfLogs/ProgramData with a mega.nz remote configured.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1048
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\winscp.com'
      - '\winscp.exe'
      - '\filezilla.exe'
  selection_origname:
    OriginalFileName: 'rclone.exe'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'mega.co.nz'
      - '--config'
      - '--transfers'
      - '--multi-thread-streams'
      - ' copy remote'
      - ' sync remote'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\Intel\'
      - '\Music\'
  condition: (selection_image or selection_origname) and selection_args and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup admins running rclone with MEGA — should be allowlisted by host and account.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE OR *\winscp.com OR *\WinSCP.com OR *\winscp.exe OR *\WinSCP.exe OR *\filezilla.exe OR *\FileZilla.exe) OR @OriginalFileName:rclone.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *--config* OR *--transfers* OR *--multi-thread-streams* OR *"copy remote"* OR *"sync remote"*) AND @Image:(*\Users\Public\* OR *\PerfLogs\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\Intel\* OR *\Music\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(rclone|winscp|filezilla)\.(exe|com)$/i
| regex("(?i)(mega:|mega\\.nz|mega\\.co\\.nz|--config|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams|copy\\s+remote|sync\\s+remote)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\\\(Users\\\\Public|PerfLogs|ProgramData|Windows\\\\Temp|Intel|Music)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Akira affiliates (CISA AA24-109A, Mandiant UNC4393) almost always use rclone configured against mega.nz as the exfil channel, typically renaming the binary and dropping it into a non-user staging dir (Public, PerfLogs, ProgramData) hours-to-days before the Akira/Megazord encryptor fires. Pairing the rclone/WinSCP image with a MEGA-flavoured cmdline AND a known staging path filters out the rare leg

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira BYOVD: Zemana zam64.sys/zamguard64.sys drop followed by EDR process kill
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature defense-evasion chain: dropping a vulnerable Zemana driver (zam64.sys / zamguard64.sys, the 'Terminator'/Spyboy family) and using it via tools like ZeroAntiAV / KillAV / Terminator to terminate EDR-protected processes before the encryptor runs. Akira / Howling Scorpius affiliates are repeatedly tied to this Zemana-driver BYOVD pattern by SentinelOne, Sophos and Trend Micro reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as path values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="zam64.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="zamguard64.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="zam32.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="zamguard32.sys") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as killEvents values(Processes.process_name) as killer values(Processes.process) as killer_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("taskkill.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","Terminator.exe","zemana.exe","KillAV.exe") OR Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelAgent*" OR Processes.process="*CSFalconService*" OR Processes.process="*xagt*" OR Processes.process="*MBAMService*" OR Processes.process="*WdNisSvc*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time | where _time>=firstTime AND _time<=firstTime+3600 | stats max(_time) as killTime values(killer) as killer values(killer_cmd) as killer_cmd by dest ] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) ctime(killTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ZemanaDrivers = dynamic(["zam64.sys","zamguard64.sys","zam32.sys","zamguard32.sys"]);
let EdrProcesses = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","SentinelAgent.exe","CSFalconService.exe","CSFalconContainer.exe","xagt.exe","MBAMService.exe","WdNisSvc.exe","CylanceSvc.exe","SophosED.exe","elastic-agent.exe"]);
let DriverDrop =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName in~ (ZemanaDrivers)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","setup.exe")
    | project DriverDropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverPath = FolderPath, DriverName = FileName,
              DropProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let EdrKill =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","PCHunter64.exe","ProcessHacker.exe","Terminator.exe","ZeroAntiAV.exe","KillAV.exe"))
            or ProcessCommandLine has_any (EdrProcesses)
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, KillProcess = FileName, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine, KillUser = AccountName;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner EdrKill on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (DriverDropTime .. DriverDropTime + 1h)
| project DriverDropTime, KillTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', KillTime, DriverDropTime),
          DeviceName, DriverName, DriverPath, DropProcess, DropCmd, DropUser,
          KillProcess, KillCmd, KillUser
| order by DriverDropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ZemanaDrivers = dynamic(["zam64.sys","zamguard64.sys","zam32.sys","zamguard32.sys"]);
let EdrProcesses = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","SentinelAgent.exe","CSFalconService.exe","xagt.exe","MBAMService.exe","WdNisSvc.exe","CylanceSvc.exe","SophosED.exe"]);
let DriverDrop =
    Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 11
    | extend TargetFilename = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.EventData.Data[?(@.Name == 'TargetFilename')]['#text'])
    | extend ImageProc = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.EventData.Data[?(@.Name == 'Image')]['#text'])
    | where TargetFilename has_any (ZemanaDrivers)
    | project DriverDropTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, DriverPath = TargetFilename, DropProcess = ImageProc;
let EdrKill =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any (dynamic(["\\taskkill.exe","\\net.exe","\\sc.exe","\\PCHunter64.exe","\\ProcessHacker.exe","\\Terminator.exe","\\KillAV.exe"]))
         or CommandLine has_any (EdrProcesses)
    | project KillTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, KillProcess = NewProcessName, KillCmd = CommandLine, KillUser = SubjectUserName;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner EdrKill on Computer
| where KillTime between (DriverDropTime .. DriverDropTime + 1h)
| project DriverDropTime, KillTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', KillTime, DriverDropTime),
          Computer, DriverPath, DropProcess, KillProcess, KillCmd, KillUser
| order by DriverDropTime desc

title: Akira BYOVD - Zemana vulnerable driver drop

status: experimental
description: Detects creation of the Zemana zam64.sys / zamguard64.sys vulnerable driver outside of its legitimate installer context — a known Akira / Howling Scorpius BYOVD building block.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
references:

  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/h/akira-ransomware.html
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1562.001
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\zam64.sys'
      - '\zamguard64.sys'
      - '\zam32.sys'
      - '\zamguard32.sys'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\Zemana AntiMalware Setup.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Zemana AntiMalware installation on engineering / IR hosts.
level: high

#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(zam(guard)?(64|32))\.sys$/i

| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
